body: Create an animation-ready modular 2D cel shaded fantasy game cutout atlas, Arcane Vanguard style, bold clean dark outlines, painterly cel shading, detailed but readable at small size. Landscape high-resolution image on TRUE transparent alpha. SIX separate equally sized panels arranged THREE columns TWO rows. View directions reading order: E right profile, SE front-right threequarter, SW front-left threequarter, W left profile, NW rear-left threequarter, NE rear-right threequarter. Rear views show BACK of skull/hair, BACK of clothing, no face or front chest ornament. Every panel contains exactly12 ISOLATED BODY PIECES in3columns4rows, consistent local ordering: row1 head, upper torso from neck to waist ONLY, rear cape; row2 pelvis/skirt, anatomical left upperarm, right upperarm; row3 left forearm including hand, right forearm including hand, left leg without foot; row4 right leg without foot, left boot, right boot. No full figures. Head entirely detached from torso. Arms split at elbows. Legs stop at ankles. NO equipment or effects in body sheet. Large transparent gutters between every cutout and everypanel. Avoid labels, checkerboard, background, panels, borders. Do not connect pieces. Full consistent identity across six genuine rotations. Subject: Stocky undead gravedigger, broad gray decayed face with sunken green eyes under battered wide brim brown hat, muddy charcoal work coat, leather apron and broad belt, patched trousers and heavy muddy boots. Hulking practical laborer not skeleton wizard.
equipment: Create 2D cel shaded fantasy game weapon cutout atlas on true transparent alpha, matching dark outlined painterly Arcane Vanguard necromancer reference style. EXACT SIX isolated views of same prop,3columns2rows in order E rightprofile,SE front-right,SW front-left,W leftprofile,NW rear-left,NE rear-right. Entire prop vertically oriented, long shaft fully visible, generous empty gutters. No hands/characters/letters/grid/background/cast shadows. Maintain correct rear details. Prop: heavy iron grave shovel with long dark wooden handle and worn broad spade blade. Color theme matches Stocky undead gravedigger, broad gray decayed face with sunken green eyes under battered wide brim brown hat, muddy charcoal work coat, leather apron and broad belt, patched trousers and heavy muddy boots. Hulking practical laborer not skeleton wizard.
effects: Transparent 2D hand-painted cel shaded fantasy GAME VFX SPRITESHEET. Exactly8columns4rows,32 individual animation frames. Each row one8frame left-to-right animation. Large transparent gutters between frames and rows. All cells same size, effect centered, frame0 small beginning then development then frame7 almost vanished. Absolutely no background haze rectangles, no whole-sheet mist, no text or grid, alpha outside individual effects ZERO. Arcane Vanguard boldclean shapes with subtle limited glow. ROW1: Iron shovel swing trail, muddy brown gray crescent arc growing and fading, no weapon or hands. ROW2: Earth and stone hit spark explosion in muted beige gray, expand then dissipate. ROW3: Open Grave: soil cracks, dark grave mouth opens with small green wisps, then settles; art effect only, no permanent object. ROW4: Small muted green undead summoning swirl rises and disperses. No characters or weapons.
